title: Battle of Mortara
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Mortara", at revision 1382463423, opens: "The Battle of Mortara was fought between 19,000 Austrian and 26,000 Italian forces on 21 March 1849. It was an Austrian tactical success." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q17622484, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle between Austrian and Italian forces in 1849". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
